_comment: Stack table for /pm-scaffold. A stack names the Claude Code plugins a repo of that kind needs, so they are enabled per repo and stay out of the global setup. Edit this list to change what a stack gets; scripts/stacks.py reads it. 'detect' entries are paths relative to the repo root (a trailing / means a folder, a leading *. means any file with that extension at the root).

filemaker.label: FileMaker file built through Claris ADT and FM Lens
filemaker.note: The claris and fm-agent-lens marketplaces are added per machine; a machine without them cannot install these.
